en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Haroun Bin Imran Al Hamdany who said,

‘There was (a debt) upon me of five hundred Dinars for the hand (of the 12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), and I was constricted due to it and fed up. Then I said within myself, ‘The shops which I have acquired with five hundred and thirty Dinars, I have made these to be for the hand (of the 12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) for five hundred Dinars’, and I did not speak with it.
So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to Muhammad Bin Ja’far: ‘Seize the shops from Muhammad Bin Haroun due to the five hundred Dinars which are for us<sup>asws</sup> upon him’.
